facts.name: Prairie Smoke
facts.color: Nodding pink flowers, feathery seed heads
facts.notes: Nodding pink flowers in spring turn into wispy pink seed plumes that look like smoke. A low front-edge plant for a sunny, dry spot.

credit.file: Geum triflorum - prairie smoke - Flickr - Matt Lavin.jpg

sources.title: Wild Cherry Farm: Prairie Smoke
sources.note: State threatened in Michigan (only native plants are state-listed).

companions.why: Grows well with blazing star and little bluestem; often grows with prairie dropseed in natural settings.
